events.strFilename: Boxing 2025-09-13 Canelo Alvarez vs Terence Crawford
events.strDescriptionEN:
Canelo Álvarez faces Terence “Bud” Crawford on Saturday, September 13, 2025, at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas in one of the year’s biggest boxing events.

Álvarez, the undisputed super-middleweight champion (63-2-2, 39 KOs), brings power, body punching, and vast experience at 168 lbs. Crawford (41-0, 31 KOs), a master technician and switch-hitter, moves up two weight classes chasing history as the first male boxer of the four-belt era to become undisputed in three divisions.

The main question is whether Crawford’s speed, timing, and ring IQ can offset Canelo’s size, strength, and pressure. If Álvarez lands heavy early shots, he could grind out a decision or force a late stoppage. If Crawford adapts and controls the pace, he has a real chance to outbox the champion over 12 rounds.

It’s power versus precision, size versus skill, with undisputed stakes and legacy on the line — a true super fight.
events.strResult:
Terence “Bud” Crawford defeated Saúl “Canelo” Álvarez by unanimous decision, with scores of 116-112, 115-113, and 115-113. Moving up two weight divisions, Crawford relied on speed, movement, and sharp counters to control most of the fight. Canelo had success to the body and in short bursts but couldn’t consistently cut off the ring or impose his power.

With the victory, Crawford became the undisputed super-middleweight champion and the first male boxer of the four-belt era to claim undisputed status in three weight classes. He improved to 42-0 (31 KOs), while Canelo acknowledged the result and praised Crawford’s performance after the bout.
